{{Quote|Harkun, you fool. In any other group for any other Lord, this young man would have torn the other acolytes to shreds.|[[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Zash|Zash]]|audio=LordZash-FfonAlthe-TOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Ffon Althe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After Althe was brought to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Harkun]] presided over Althe's initial [[Sith training]] in the ways of a [[Sith Inquisitor]] on behalf of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Zash|Zash]], who was looking for an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]].

Althe was afforded unfair advantages by Harkun, who believed the elevation of Force-sensitive members of the Empire's [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] caste was harming the Sith cause. Despite this favoritism and his Sith blood, he was bested by a [[Darth Nox|competing acolyte]], and was executed by Lord Zash.

==Biography==
The protégé of Overseer Harkun, Althe was given every advantage possible. Despite this and his considerable ability, he was outperformed by a [[Darth Nox|fellow Acolyte]], a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] that was eventually favored by Lord Zash. During his training, Ffon was many times asked by Harkun to show off his powers to intimidate the other acolytes. In one of these displays, he even executed his fellow acolyte, [[Gerr]], with a burst of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].<ref name="TOR" />

For his final trial, he and the remaining Acolyte were tasked to venture into [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] [[Tomb of Naga Sadow|tomb]] to bring back a map to present to Lord Zash. Harkun, eager to give Althe every advantage possible, gave him a head start. Unfortunately for Ffon, Zash arrived shortly thereafter, and briefed the remaining Acolyte on critical information regarding the tomb's contents she had only just discovered. Zash saw no reason to recall Althe to give him the same information, since he had been shown favoritism from the start, and not from her.<ref name="TOR" />

Althe failed his final task, while his slave-caste peer succeeded, with the help of the ancient [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] servant of [[Tulak Hord]], [[Khem Val]]. Not willing to be bested, Harkun took the map off the acolyte and gave it to Althe, demanding he take credit for retrieving it. When the Pureblood acolyte presented the map to Zash, she was skeptical in believing Althe's apparent success, and instead she demanded the truth. In fear of Zash, Althe came clean and apologized for lying, but was still promptly [[Death/Legends|executed]] by the Sith Lord. As Ffon died, Zash chided Harkun for his favoritism, speculating that Althe would have come out on top if all of the Acolytes had been treated fairly—or if she had not been the one they had been competing for.<ref name="TOR" />

==Powers and abilities==
Ffon Althe was capable of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] powerful enough to badly injure fellow acolyte [[Gerr]].
